svg.title: RGB badge rear footprint and battery-over-board fit trial
svg.text: REAR · proposed dual N/P packages and power-IC minima; geometry only
Original coupon capture: 410 parts; 32 row FETs hypothetically replaced by 16 pair boxes.
Retained captured non-row parts unplaced: 0; under-pack 0402: 77 conditional.
Dual MOSFETs and power ICs are package reservations; support circuits and routing remain.
Battery needs case support above the board; height and circuit locality are unqualified.
VLED passives are XY-only; NO routes, thermal copper, remaining power support, mount or antenna.
3 × 3 mm boxes use a first-author footprint; assembly and pin map need independent review.
